summary: Thursday's close was driven by a Fed official pushing for another rate hike, sending Treasury yields toward 19-year highs. That hammered long bonds and lifted the dollar, pressuring gold to fresh monthly lows on inflation worries, while equity gains stayed concentrated in tech as broader breadth lagged sharply.
tweet: Hawkish Fed talk drove yields to 19-year highs, hammering bonds and gold while tech masked thin equity breadth.
